text: Entry 1514 sets the notification button title from the cta attribute. Current attribute handling updates visible text, visibility and title, while test_cta_title checks two successive values. Proposed rule for this CTA: update derived tooltip text on replacement, not only creation. A title tooltip is not a substitute for visible text or a verified accessible name; optional CTA visibility has a separate existing contract. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.
title: Update the CTA tooltip when its visible text changes
